newsitem.title: USA: Green Tree CEO 1996 bonus at $102 mln.
newsitem.headline: Green Tree CEO 1996 bonus at $102 mln.

text.p: Lawrence Coss, chief executive officer and chairman of Green Tree Financial Corp, was paid a salary of $433,608 for 1996 and received a $102,015,158 bonus, according to a regulatory filing.

In a proxy filed with the Securities and Exchange Commission on Wednesday, Green Tree said the bonus includes $94.65 million, which it said was equivalent to 2.4 million of its common shares, before federal and state tax withholdings.

Terms of a new five-year pact effective January 1, 1997 call for an increase in base salary to $600,000. Coss's base salary has not increased since 1985. He will also be awarded a two million share stock option.

Compensation for Coss, 58, for 1996 is based entirely on an employement agreement between him and Green Tree entered into in 1991, extending similar employment and compensation arrangements in effect since 1983, the proxy said.

The 1991 employment agreement, which expired on December 31, 1996, provided that, in addition to a base annual salary of $400,000, Coss would receive an annual bonus as provided in his employment contract, Green Tree said in the proxy.
